An Act amending title 14, chapter 24, section 503 of the Virgin Islands Code by adding definitions of
sexual conduct and sexual contact and by amending title 14, chapter 85, section 1699 by adding a
definition of sexual conduct and amending the definition of sexual contact

Be it enacted by the Legislature ofthe Virgin Islands:
SECTION 1. Title 14, chapter 24, section 503 of the Virgin Islands Code is amended by adding
subsections (i) and (j) to read:
"(i) `sexual conduct' means actual or simulated:

(I) sexual intercourse, including genital—genital, oral-genital, anal-genital, or oral-anal,
whether between persons of the same or opposite sex;
(2) penetration of the vagina or rectum by any object except when done as part of a

"(c) 'sexual conduct' means actual or simulated:

(I) Sexual intercourse, including genital to genital, oral to genital, anal to genital, or oralanal, whether between persons of the same or opposite sex.
